Ivy (DevRel): Heads up - Spectra sent INV-9902 for $7,620 dated 2026-03-20. Coupa didn't match. Vendor claims PO# SP-302 but our system has no SP prefix. Anyone seen this?
Aisha - Procurement: SP-302 isn't in our current schema. Spectra used old vendor prefix. @Spectra Billing can you attach the invoice PDF and state the original PO creation date?
Spectra Billing: Invoice and PDF: https://spectra.example/inv/INV-9902. PO on file shows SP-302 created 2024-12-05. We can reissue with new PO number if you provide it.
Lucas (Finance): We need PO or explicit approval for payment. Also need GL and cost center. Ivy, what team owns this spend?
Ivy (DevRel): This is for conference booth and demo credits under DevRel Q2 events. Use GL 6102, cost center DEVREL-ENG.
POBot: Checking legacy records... SP-302 -> MATCH found: PO_LEG_SP302, assigned to SPECTRA on 2024-12-05, status ARCHIVED. Owner: Aisha - Procurement. Recommendation: reopen or create PO-2026-445 and reference legacy id.
Aisha - Procurement: I'll create PO-2026-445 and link SP-302. Spectra, please resend invoice with PO=PO-2026-445. Also confirm tax breakdown and whether any promotional credit was applied.
Spectra Billing: We'll resend same-day with the new PO. Tax breakdown: taxable services $6,800; tax $620; no promo credit applied.
Marta (Ops): Quick note: the invoice includes 2 line items flagged as "setup fee" and "onsite support". Can you add brief descriptions for each line to match expense policy?
Spectra Billing: We'll add descriptions and the event code EVT-2026-04 per your request.
Samir (CFO): I approve provisional payment up to $6,500 pending corrected invoice and PO link. Hold $1,120 for verification of setup/onsite hours and tax. Finance to annotate memo "provisional - events spend".
Lucas (Finance): Got it. Queuing provisional release for $6,500 and marking $1,120 on hold until Spectra sends corrected invoice and line descriptions. Aisha, please update procurement ticket PRQ-2026-124 once PO created.
Aisha - Procurement: PO-2026-445 created and linked to PO_LEG_SP302. Updating ticket now.
Spectra Billing: Corrected invoice uploaded to Coupa with PO-2026-445 and item descriptions.
POBot: PO-2026-445 status: OPEN and linked.
Lucas (Finance): Received corrected invoice. Releasing provisional payment per CFO signoff. Holding flag remains until Ops confirms service hours.
Ivy (DevRel): Thanks team  I'll confirm onsite hours with event manager and close the loop.
